recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It completes the published FHIR-31986 bdl-7 resolution without duplicating or regressing the already-audited FHIR-39476 correction; broader Bundle uniqueness changes should go through a new work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-31986 was a Published/Not Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I change request asking how include/search results could contain the same resource more than once when Bundle fullUrl uniqueness appeared to forbid it. The final resolution kept the rule that a given resource version appears only once, but directed bdl-7 to compare entries with the same fullUrl where resource is present by meta.versionId.
initial_application: A source commit, d1672bb7c204f7fd6aa18a944692982e02fba3e7, mentioned FHIR-31986 but did not update bdl-7. The Bundle narrative already said a given resource version SHALL only appear once, but the authoritative bdl-7 expression still used the older whole-history-bundle exception and concatenated fullUrl directly with versionId.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml is in current build scope. Earlier FHIR-18284 added a broad history exception for deleted entries with no resource body; FHIR-31986 narrowed that rationale to entries where resource is absent. Later FHIR-39476 fixed absent meta.versionId handling with iif(..., '') and already has a combined-branch AutoFHIR audit, so this reconciliation preserved that later fallback.
reconciliation: Changed source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml bdl-7 human text and FHIRPath expression to filter to entries with fullUrl and resource, join fullUrl and meta.versionId with '|', and keep the iif(..., '') fallback for missing versionId.
source_changes: source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml: updated bdl-7 human text and expression from a whole-history exception to resource-present fullUrl/version uniqueness with a delimiter and missing-version fallback.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue added the broad history-bundle exception for deleted entries without resource bodies; FHIR-31986 narrows that rationale to entries where resource is present.
Later Published issue fixed absent meta.versionId handling in bdl-7; this commit preserves its iif(..., '') fallback and does not duplicate its existing AutoFHIR audit commit.
Earlier Published bdl-7 correction added the fullUrl.exists() filter and is useful background for the invariant history.
